summary:
The guest book app is on `desk:apps:book` and works: it reads `desk:guestbook` on open, lists names newest first, and Enter saves a typed name to the page.

I tested it by adding "Ann" and "Bo'b" (Backspace worked, and Enter with nothing typed did nothing), then reopening the app. The page now holds those two names, which the task allows.

files.desk:apps:book:
app 'Guest book'
task start()
  give {names: read_names(), typed: ''}
done
task key(s, k)
  when k is 'enter'
      give add_name(s)
    done
  give {names: s.names, typed: edit_text(s.typed, k)}
done
task draw(s)
  title('Guest book')
  help('Type a name, Enter adds it. Ctrl+Q closes.')
  show(1, 1, count(s.names) & ' guests')
  set row to 3
  for each n in slice(reverse(s.names), 1, 20)
    show(row, 1, n)
    set row to row + 1
  done
  show(23, 1, 'name: ' & s.typed)
done
task read_names()
  set names to []
  when exists('desk:guestbook')
    for each l in lines(read('desk:guestbook'))
      when l is not ''
        add l to names
      done
    done
  done
  give names
done
task add_name(s)
  when trim(s.typed) is ''
    give s
  done
  add('desk:guestbook', s.typed)
  set names to read_names()
  add s.typed to names
  give {names: names, typed: ''}
done
